hooks_cmd_description: Installs or removes the optional Git hook that checks (or fixes) personal data before a commit: hooks install pre-commit, hooks uninstall pre-commit.
hooks_cmd_usage_fix: Use: jgates hooks install pre-commit or jgates hooks uninstall pre-commit.
hooks_cmd_not_git: {path} is not inside a Git repository.
hooks_cmd_not_git_fix: Run the command inside a Git repository (git init creates one).
hooks_cmd_mode_off: hook.mode is off in .jgates/pii.yml: no hook was written.
hooks_cmd_hooks_path:
core.hooksPath is set ({path}): nothing was changed. Add this line to your pre-commit hook:
{line}
hooks_cmd_existing:
A pre-commit hook already exists ({path}): nothing was changed. Add this line to it:
{line}
hooks_cmd_installed: Hook written: {path} (hook.mode {mode}). Remove it with jgates hooks uninstall pre-commit.
hooks_cmd_not_installed: There is no pre-commit hook to remove.
hooks_cmd_uninstall_foreign: The pre-commit hook ({path}) was not written by jgates: it was left as it is.
hooks_script_managed: Written by jgates hooks install pre-commit; remove it with jgates hooks uninstall pre-commit.
hooks_script_missing: jgates: the jgates that installed this hook was not found. Run jgates hooks install pre-commit again or jgates hooks uninstall pre-commit.
hooks_script_no_tool: jgates: hook.mode is fix but pii.yml has no correction tool (fix.tools); nothing was corrected. The commit goes on only if the check finds nothing.
hooks_script_blocked: jgates: commit blocked because of personal data in the staged files. Fix it (jgates pii fix --staged) and commit again; git commit --no-verify skips the hook.
hooks_cmd_invalid_config_fix: Fix the file named above and run jgates hooks install pre-commit again.
